ev.q: At facility A, 65 (25%) of 265 workers who received screening reported symptoms and received testing
six (9%) of 65 (2.3% of all workers) received a positive influenza A(H5) test result
Symptom onset occurred a median of 1 day after initial occupational exposure (range = 1–8 days)
Among those who received testing, nine (8.3%) received a positive influenza A(H5) virus test result
by influenza A(H5) test result and poultry facility
Cluster of Influenza A(H5) Cases Associated with Poultry Exposure at Two Facilities

methods_quotes.q: Date of initial exposure was defined as the date when depopulation or disposal of sick poultry began
Work start date was defined as the date when depopulation or disposal of sick poultry began at the facility.
Samples were tested for influenza A(H5) via reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction
Specimens testing presumptively positive for influenza A(H5) virus or with inconclusive results were sent to CDC for confirmatory testing.
